question: What cosmic range must be encompassed when meditating on that object in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place.
That object is the focus of meditation.
The range extends from Shiva down to Avici.
inference: One should meditate on that object in every place as pervading the range from Shiva to Avici.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in place after place, one should contemplate it as ranging from Shiva down to Avici.
